fusions.name: Breaching Slug
fusions.desc: Fires a slug at an enemy up to 9 tiles away that deals 32 damage, ignores armour, and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Glancing Ricochet
fusions.desc: Fires a round into the first enemy in its path for 4 damage; it glances off to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of that damage.

fusions.name: Sloped Glacis
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Hammered Plate
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
